title: Custom 429 handling in a Zapier afterResponse never runs because core throws ThrottledError first
symptoms: afterResponse code that inspects 429 responses is skipped
Steps retry after a delay instead of failing
cause: Since 11.2.0 core retries uncaught 429 responses after a delay taken from Retry-After, and a built-in middleware throws ThrottledError before your afterResponse sees the response.
fix: Let the built-in retry handle 429 and send a Retry-After from your API, or set throwForThrottlingEarly to false on the request to handle it yourself and throw ThrottledError with a delay.
apply:
const res = await z.request({ url, throwForThrottlingEarly: false, skipThrowForStatus: true });
if (res.status === 429) throw new z.errors.ThrottledError('Rate limited', 60);
